profile_text.body:
NVIDIA is a public company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, USA, trading as NVDA. Its website presents the NVIDIA Nemotron family of multimodal foundation models, which the company describes as highly efficient, open AI models built for long-running, self-evolving agents. The site says Nemotron models deliver agentic reasoning for graduate-level science, advanced math, and visual understanding, and are available from edge to cloud on platforms including NVIDIA RTX PRO and NVIDIA DGX Spark.

The Nemotron family includes Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for specialized task completion, NeMo Switchyard for routing steps to models, Nemotron Speech models for automatic speech recognition, text-to-speech, and neural machine translation, and Nemotron Retriever models for document understanding and retrieval. NVIDIA offers these models as NVIDIA NIM microservices for deployment, and describes the NVIDIA Open Model License as permissive, allowing use, modification, distribution, and commercial deployment without crediting NVIDIA. The company also points to NVIDIA NeMo, NVIDIA Blueprints, and NVIDIA AI Enterprise for building and deploying agentic AI.

NVIDIA's most recent 10-K reports revenue of $215,938,000,000 for the period ending January 25, 2026. California legal records show 281 matters involving NVIDIA. The company's product records describe NVIDIA Nemotron as an enterprise LLM family with synthetic data generation, GPU optimization, and self-hosted options, and NVIDIA NIM as inference microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options.
